premise_review: Read all19356 original bytes and20939 organized bytes separately. No original mathematical field or premise is removed. All original imports, documentation and universe u are retained in each component.
GF2 is ZMod2; Boolean XOR is addition under the coefficient map and AND is pointwise product. Zero divisors require 1 < m*n. The empty product m*n=0 and one-entry1x1 cases are separate exact results.

Encoding explicitly supplies F:Type u, [Field F], [Fintype F], [Algebra GF2 F] and a GF2-linear equivalence to finite matrix coordinates. Cardinality alone supplies neither this model nor additive compatibility.

Every transported operation retains E. The mul/inv laws keep their exact nonzero hypotheses; multiplication differs from AND only under the full supplied-model and dimension premises. No instances on Bool/raw matrices are added.

The fieldQuantizer has full image only because E.code is an equivalence; the original general Quantizer provider defines effective states as its image subtype. No arbitrary encoder-surjectivity claim follows.

Original BitMatrix.FiniteField namespace deliberately retained per parent approval, physical subject GRWTSK finite fields. Exact original fully qualified Encoding terms and original Avalanche/SAT opens remain; duplicate source variants are not claimed safe to coimport.

Full Avalanche, Quantizer and Basic captured provider originals read, GridCell not used here. SAT context is explicitly limited to the complete required Bits declaration; no transitive Mathlib or SAT theorem bodies are counted as this review.
